title: 第3章 昨天晚上你是第一次第4章 她成了赌注
lines: 第3章：昨天晚上，你是第一次
谁知道慕迟曜听到后，不悦的皱了一下眉头，声音沉沉，低哑却十分的好听：“叫我名字。”
“这怎么行，你是天烨的哥哥，于情于理，我都应该叫你大哥，而不是直接喊你名字，太不礼貌了。”
言安希忽然觉得下巴一疼，慕迟曜已经伸手捏住了她，指尖在她脸颊上摩挲：“你是想时时刻刻提醒我，你是我弟弟的未婚妻？”
“我本来就是你弟弟的未婚妻。”
他的力道忽然加大，手指捏得越来越紧，言安希忍住下巴的疼痛，勉强和他对视。
不得不说慕迟曜的气场，太过强大了，她根本不是对手。
“是我弟弟的未婚妻又怎样？”慕迟曜把她逼到墙角，大手却揽着她纤细的腰肢，“如果我没记错的话，昨天晚上，你是第一次。”
昨晚昨晚，又是昨晚！
言安希现在总算明白了什么叫做喝酒误事了！
“慕天烨他的确是没有碰过我，但是谁说女人的第一次，一定会见红？只要我咬死不承认……”
慕迟曜打断她的话：“你确定？如果我当着他的面，要了你的身子呢？”
言安希死死的咬着下唇：“你……变态！”
慕迟曜松开她的下巴，修长的指尖顺着她的嘴角，开始慢慢往下滑。
言安希僵直了身体，一动也不敢动，只能再紧咬着下唇，往墙角缩去。
慕迟曜已经贴了上来，在她耳边呵出热气：“不要这么紧张，这么漂亮的红唇，咬出印子就不讨人喜欢了。”
言安希忽然就想起慕城里，对眼前这个男人的传闻。
冷漠，孤傲，不苟言笑，有着至高无上的身份，也有着让人捉摸不透的怪脾气。
可是她怎么也看不出，眼前这个总是对她说一些不堪入耳的话的男人，就是传闻中的慕迟曜。
这根本对不上号啊。
那他肯定是存心在逗她玩了。
可是言安希玩不起啊，如果没有嫁给慕天烨，她没有了这个身份，她就没有了钱。
她需要钱，为了钱，她可以牺牲自己的婚姻。
慕迟曜的手已经从她衣领里伸进去了，他的指腹有一层薄薄的茧子，言安希能清楚的感受到他的每一个动作。
她几乎要哭出来了。
慕迟曜看见她这个模样，忽然冷哼了一声，一把推开了她，从她身上抽身离开，毫不掩饰他的不悦和嫌弃。
言安希一只手紧紧的抓住自己的衣领，把眼泪硬生生的给收了回去。
她慢慢的抬起眼睛，忽然一怔，目光越过慕迟曜的肩膀，愣愣的看向客厅门口。

Chapter 3: Last night was your first time
Who knew that after Mu Chi Yao heard this, he frowned displeased and said in a deep, hoarse but pleasant voice: "Call my name."
"How can this be done? You are Tian Ye's brother. For reasons and reasons, I should call you brother instead of calling you by your name directly. It's too rude."
Yan Anxi suddenly felt a pain in her jaw. Mu Chi Yao had reached out to pinch her, and rubbed her cheek with his fingertips: "Do you want to remind me all the time that you are my brother's fiancée?"
"I was originally your brother's fiancée."
His strength suddenly increased, and his fingers squeezed tighter and tighter. Yan Anxi endured the pain in her jaw and reluctantly looked at him.
It had to be said that Mu Chi Yao's aura was so powerful that she was no match for him.
"So what if she is my brother's fiancée?" Mu Chi Yao forced her into a corner, but held her slender waist with his big hands, "If I remember correctly, last night was your first time."
Last night, last night, last night again!
Yan Anxi now finally understands what it means to drink and make trouble!
"Mu Tianye has indeed never touched me, but who said that a woman's first time will definitely make her red? As long as I bite my tongue and refuse to admit it..."
Mu Chi Yao interrupted her: "Are you sure? What if I take your body in front of him?"
Yan Anxi bit her lower lip: "You...pervert!"
Mu Chi Yao let go of her chin, and his slender fingertips began to slide down slowly along the corners of her mouth.
Yan Anxi stiffened her body and did not dare to move. She could only bite her lower lip tightly and shrink back to the corner.
Mu Chi Yao had already moved closer and breathed hot breath into her ear: "Don't be so nervous. Such beautiful red lips will not be flattering if you bite them."
Yan Anxi suddenly remembered the rumors about the man in front of him in Mu City.
Indifferent, aloof, unsmiling, with a supreme status, he also has an unpredictable and strange temper.
But she couldn't figure out that the man in front of her who always said some unpleasant things to her was the rumored Mu Chi Yao.
This doesn't match the number at all.
Then he must be teasing her on purpose.
But Yan Anxi couldn't afford it. If she hadn't married Mu Tianye, she wouldn't have this identity, and she would have no money.
She needs money, and for money, she can sacrifice her marriage.
Mu Chi Yao's hand had already reached into her collar. There was a thin layer of calluses on his fingertips, and Yan Anxi could clearly feel every move he made.
She almost cried.
When Mu Chi Yao saw her like this, he suddenly snorted coldly, pushed her away, and pulled away from her, without concealing his displeasure and disgust.
Yan Anxi grabbed her collar tightly with one hand and held back her tears.
She slowly raised her eyes and was suddenly startled. She looked over Mu Chi Yao's shoulder and looked blankly at the door of the living room.
